card.name: Proper names ending a title phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a fixed proper-name phrase, such as Union, Congress or State after 'of the'. It also fires on names like Nero and on the start of Tagore.

modes.label: Institution names
modes.description: Final word of a government or national body name, often in a source line.

modes.label: Historic names
modes.description: A person's or country's name in a history passage.
modes.example: was beheaded by the emperor<< Nero>> for his faith around 65 A

modes.label: Alcohol words
modes.description: Alcohol or ethanol in a drug interaction note.
modes.example: Verapamil has been found to significantly inhibit<< ethanol>> elimination
